tour.title: Smart Search
tour.body: Type or ask anything naturally. We will help you discover healthy local restaurant foods, recipes to cook, or log nutritional values.

tour.title: Eat Out Wisely
tour.body: Find menu hacks and nutritional choices from popular dining spots near you, calibrated instantly to your target daily limits.

tour.title: Custom Cook Mode
tour.body: Explore recipes tailored to your active ingredients or preference. Filter instantly by high protein, speed, or minimal prep options.

tour.title: Logging & Tracking
tour.body: Quickly review your daily nutrition, log dishes, and watch your targets update dynamically as you eat and move throughout the week.
